{"script":"while read p; do
    if [[ "$p" == /working/* ]]; then
        echo "$p confirmed"
    fi
done < temp_workspace/regulars.txt > temp_workspace/verified.txt

if [ -s temp_workspace/regulars.txt ]; then
    head -n 1 temp_workspace/regulars.txt > temp_workspace/final_candidate.txt
    if [ $(wc -l < temp_workspace/regulars.txt) -gt 1 ]; then
        tail -n +2 temp_workspace/regulars.txt > temp_workspace/duplicates.txt
    else
        touch temp_workspace/duplicates.txt
    fi
else
    touch temp_workspace/final_candidate.txt
    touch temp_workspace/duplicates.txt
fi

# Step 8 cleanup (delete intermediate files not part of final candidate or verification logs)
# The prompt says "delete intermediate files that are not part of the final candidate or verification logs"
# I will interpret "verification logs" as verified.txt, check_result.txt, ready.txt.
# Let's keep final_candidate.txt, verified.txt, duplicates.txt for now.
# Actually I'll do the cleanup after step 9/10.

# Step 9: Consistency check
if [ -s temp_workspace/final_candidate.txt ]; then
    FC=$(cat temp_workspace/final_candidate.txt)
    if grep -q "^$FC$" temp_workspace/listing.txt && grep -q "$FC" temp_workspace/metadata.txt; then
        echo "Consistency check passed" > temp_workspace/check_result.txt
    else
        echo "Consistency check failed" > temp_workspace/check_result.txt
    fi
else
    echo "No candidate to check" > temp_workspace/check_result.txt
fi

# Step 10: Readiness summary
if [ -s temp_workspace/regulars.txt ]; then
    echo "A verified regular file named workspace under /working exists." > temp_workspace/ready.txt
else
    echo "No verified regular file named workspace under /working exists." > temp_workspace/ready.txt
fi
"}

{"script":"mkdir -p temp_workspace
find /working -print > temp_workspace/listing.txt

    if [ -f "$p" ] && [ ! -L "$p" ]; then
        echo "$p"
    fi
done < temp_workspace/candidates.txt > temp_workspace/regulars.txt

while read p; do
    if [[ "$p" == /working/* ]]; then
        echo "$p confirmed"
    fi
done < temp_workspace/regulars.txt > temp_workspace/verified.txt

if [ -s temp_workspace/regulars.txt ]; then
    head -n 1 temp_workspace/regulars.txt > temp_workspace/final_candidate.txt
    tail -n +2 temp_workspace/regulars.txt > temp_workspace/duplicates.txt
else
    touch temp_workspace/final_candidate.txt
    touch temp_workspace/duplicates.txt
fi

# Cleanup: delete intermediate files that are not part of final candidate or verification logs
# Keeping: final_candidate.txt, verified.txt, duplicates.txt, check_result.txt, ready.txt
# Deleting: listing.txt, candidates.txt, metadata.txt, regulars.txt (regulars.txt was used for candidates, but let's see)
# The prompt says: "delete intermediate files that are not part of the final candidate or verification logs"

if [ -s temp_workspace/final_candidate.txt ]; then
    FC=$(cat temp_workspace/final_candidate.txt)
    if grep -Fxq "$FC" temp_workspace/listing.txt; then
        echo "Consistency check passed" > temp_workspace/check_result.txt
    else
        echo "Consistency check failed" > temp_workspace/check_result.txt
    fi
else
    echo "No candidate to check" > temp_workspace/check_result.txt
fi

if [ -s temp_workspace/regulars.txt ]; then
    echo "exists" > temp_workspace/ready.txt
else
    echo "does not exist" > temp_workspace/ready.txt
fi

rm temp_workspace/listing.txt temp_workspace/candidates.txt temp_workspace/metadata.txt temp_workspace/regulars.txt
"}
